flows.title: Connect a store or marketplace
steps: Select Selling Channels from the sidebar, then choose Store Setup.
Click Connect a Store or Marketplace.
Select the selling channel you wish to add. Use the search bar to filter the selling channel list if you do not see your store platform.
Follow the on-screen instructions to add your store.

You are then taken to the Store Settings section of the Store Setup page, where you can edit the store's display name, enable or disable the auto-update feature, set your marketplace and customer notifications, and customize the store's branding.
Click Save Changes if you altered anything.
